# Advisor brief

<!-- generated by omp-make-advisor; edit statuses inline (keep|drop) -->

## conc-1 · keep — Any change to scan state must keep it per-binding inside the extension factory closure, never hoisted to module scope
Evidence: index.ts:9-15
Rationale: omp re-runs the extension factory inside task subagents against the same module instance, so module-level state would let a scout's own agent_end/tool_execution_end close or corrupt the root session's scan phase (the exact near-miss the 2026 "harden scan event wiring" refactor guarded against).

## conc-2 · keep — The agent_end handler must keep the willContinue gate ahead of the scanState.active check-and-clear sequence
Evidence: index.ts:83-88
Rationale: agent_end settles fire for every auto-retry/continuation, not just terminal ones, so a refactor that reorders or drops the willContinue early-return consumes scanState.active on a non-final settle and fires the "brief not written" warning before the scouts' final settle has written advisor-brief.md.

## conc-3 · keep — Every new exit path added to TrapPicker must route through finish() so the done callback resolves exactly once
Evidence: src/picker.ts:76-88
Rationale: Select-onEnter, SelectList's own Esc/Ctrl+C cancel, and the app.interrupt keybinding match already overlap as racing termination paths over the same overlay promise; bypassing the doneCalled re-entrancy guard would call done twice, double-resolving ctx.ui.custom and double-running the host's dispose/exit (pinned by "done must fire exactly once" in test/tui/picker.test.ts).

## err-1 · keep — Any change to the `/oma` brief-read failure path must preserve the ENOENT-vs-other-errno split instead of collapsing to a generic "run scan" hint
Evidence: index.ts:30-38
Rationale: The discriminator plus `code ?? "unknown error"` is the only thing keeping an EACCES/EISDIR on an existing advisor-brief.md from being softened into misleading "re-scanning will fix it" advice, as the inline comment itself warns.

## err-2 · keep — Any change to the `agent_end` handler must keep the `willContinue` guard ahead of the phase reset and must still warn when the scan settles without a written, parseable brief
Evidence: index.ts:85-100
Rationale: Resetting `scanState` on an auto-retry settle or adding any early return between the reset and the readBrief/skipped-count verification would turn a failed scout phase into silent success — the event-driven design has no other place that verifies the brief landed.

## err-3 · keep — Any change to the scan E2E must keep the watchdog declared before `try` and the `finally` performing `clearTimeout` + `proc.kill()` + `rmSync` as the last word
Evidence: test/e2e/scan.e2e.test.ts:98-129
Rationale: The documented near-miss is that bun abandons a timed-out test without unwinding it, so an early return, a reordered declaration, or a dropped finally-kill leaks a live omp process and the `oma-e2e-*` temp fixture directory.

## data-1 · keep — Any change to the advisor-brief block shape must update src/scan.ts's prompt literal and src/brief.ts's regex/writer in the same change
Evidence: src/brief.ts:22-29
Rationale: The header, comment, and block-header grammar (`## <id> · <status> — <title>` / `Evidence:` / `Rationale:`) are duplicated verbatim across the two files with no cross-check, and a mismatch fails silently — non-matching blocks are counted as `skipped` and surface only inside a notify string — while brief.test.ts exercises the parser with synthetic fixtures that never touch the prompt text.

## data-3 · keep — Any WATCHDOG.md/WATCHDOG.yml emitter must land together with a golden round-trip test that mirrors OMP's advisor serializer semantics
Evidence: docs/design-docs/DESIGN.md:26
Rationale: The emitted pair's only real consumer is OMP's advisor config discovery/serializer, so YAML that drifts from those semantics (folded instead of literal block scalars, non-canonical keys, lossy round-trip) passes this repo's own tests yet is silently rejected or mangled at runtime in the target project — the golden test is the sole guard and must not be deferred past the emitter (f-004/f-007).

## build-1 · keep — Any change that renames, moves, or adds an extension entry file must update the `"omp"."extensions"` manifest and `"main"` in package.json in the same change
Evidence: package.json:6-8
Rationale: Installed-plugin discovery resolves only manifest `extensions` entries with no `index.ts` fallback on the lock path, and dev flows (`omp -e`, `npm run probe`) keep working after a desync — the 2026-09-06 first-install incident had `/oma` silently fall through to plain model prose (PROGRESS.md:143-152).

## build-2 · keep — Any change to test tooling or the extension's import graph must keep both test suites running under bun, never a node/tsx-based runner
Evidence: package.json:11-13
Rationale: `@oh-my-pi/pi-tui` imports `bun:` protocols, so node cannot load the extension graph (`ERR_UNSUPPORTED_ESM_URL_SCHEME`, PROGRESS.md:155-165) — a future "normalize to node/vitest" switch (invited by `engines: node>=22`) would fail while piped verification masked the exit code last time.

## build-3 · keep — Any new test suite must ship wired into a package.json script that init.sh runs — the `test` glob `test/*.test.ts` is non-recursive and init.sh hardcodes test + test:tui
Evidence: init.sh:70-72
Rationale: Suites in `test/` subdirectories run only via their own script entries (`test:tui`, env-gated `test:e2e`), and the wiring was added manually per suite — upcoming f-004/f-006/f-007 golden and snapshot suites dropped into a new subdir would leave init.sh green without ever executing them.
